description: This file contains unit tests for the MemoryAppender class in the OpenMRS project, verifying logging behavior such as message appending, buffer size management, and integration with Log4j.

classes.name: MemoryAppenderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class to verify the functionality of MemoryAppender in logging scenarios within the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the MemoryAppender and sets up the logger before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the logger and MemoryAppender after each test.

methods.name: memoryAppender_shouldAppendAMessage
methods.description: Tests that a single log message is correctly appended to the MemoryAppender.

methods.name: memoryAppender_shouldAppendMultipleMessages
methods.description: Verifies that multiple log messages are appended correctly and all are retrievable.

methods.name: memoryAppender_shouldOnlyKeepBufferSizeItems
methods.description: Ensures that the MemoryAppender respects its buffer size limit by discarding oldest entries.

methods.name: setupLogger
methods.description: Configures the logger to use the MemoryAppender with specified settings.
